Dialog: (Scene opens on the backyard. Buford is standing there all by himself.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hmmm... Feels like somethin' is missin'.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, what have you done?

Name: Buford
Dialog: You're gonna hafta wait for my tell-all memoir just like everyone else.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whatcha do—Oh, it's just you.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The more pressing question is, "Where are Phineas and Ferb?"

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wait. What's this button?

Name: Phineas hologram
Dialog: Hey, gang, Ferb and I are hanging out with Mom this afternoon, so make yourselves at home till we get back. In the meantime...

Name: Ferb hologram
Dialog: Nature abhors a vacuum.

Name: Phineas hologram
Dialog: Feel free to get started without us. See ya soon. (to Ferb hologram) Hologram tricks!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Whoo! Opportunity! We can carpe our own diem! (unrolls a blueprint) How about Radical Barbarian Battles?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Origami mech suits?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Anti-gravity water slides?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What about your Bread Bowl Hot Tub?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't wanna stew with just you two.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, we have to do something. We can't have nothing to show for our day when Phineas gets here.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And Ferb.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes, and Ferb. (She gasps as she notices the holograms suddenly sitting on her head. Ferb is reeling in Phineas' head with a fishing pole.) Is there an off switch?

Name: Phineas hologram
Dialog: Hey, where is Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Howdy, Agent P. Doof's been experimenting with recombinant DNA. And it isn't pretty.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Whatever you're thinking it is, it's much worse.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Get over there ASAP. Just... maybe do it on an empty stomach.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm usually here, and Phineas is usually right beside me.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (drops boxes) No! This is my spot! You go just here. And Buford...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Spread out, you two! Spread out! Right here is where I do my best commenting and quipping.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This could be a chance for me to shine as an individual.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: For us to shine together.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes, for us to make me shine together.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Here, put these on. They'll help me remember your names while we're workin' on my invention.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You two keep yappin'! I'm gonna work on my own idea.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Fine! We all build our own thing! May the best man win!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is not a contest, Buford! (quietly) But I am so going to win.

Name: Candace
Dialog: To bust or not to bust. Eh, they're not my brothers, so I'm not sure it'd even count. But maybe if Mom sees this, it'll lend a little credence to all the other things I told her about. Yes! (She suddenly is holding two pairs of binoculars.) To bust!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen, gravelly voice) Perry the Platypus, how nice of you to bug me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Which is appropriate because... Behold...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I have evolved!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks to my pupa-inator. See I saw this documentary on how butterflies evolved from the pupa and they get their wings and become their best selves! So I made myself a pupa-inator so that I can become my best self and therefore take over the Tri-State Area! What, what, what? it's not good? It's... It's no bueno? What? I guess I haven't looked at myself in the mirror. Lemme... (sees his reflection) Oh! Oh, man, I'm not a beautiful butterfly at all! I'm a big gross moth thingy! (He looks at his lab coat, which has bite marks all over it.) Well, I guess that explains the strange urge to eat clothes. Maybe I should just turn myself back into a—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wai-wai-wait! Or... go with me here... I make everyone else a moth. Cuz, y'know, like in a city of men, I'm like a four at best. But in a city of mothmans, who knows? I could be like a... like a six!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's find out. Huh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mmmm, oh. That lining, delicious. I'm gonna be in my closet looking for more hats.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Your hat, Agent P! If the microchip in your fedora's been damaged, our entire security system could be compromised! You must report immediately to the OWCA haberdasher and get a new hat with a new chip.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, Agent P, be careful!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We'll text you the coordinates.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus. More hat. Doofmoth needs more hat.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, pick up. Mom, pick up. Mom, pick up. Mom, pick up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Y'ello? Linda Flynn-Fletcher's phone, Phineas speaking.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gah! Phineas, please tell Mom there's, uh, something really cool in the backyard she needs to come and see.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Really?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yes. Baljeet, Isabella, and Buford have been busy little bees.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes! Good for them! Mom, let's head home! Candace wants us to see something!

Name: Candace
Dialog: EEE!

Name: Linda
Dialog: If I had a nickel for every time Candace promised to show me something and nothing was there, I'd have $5.20, which isn't a lot, but it's weird that it's happened a hundred and four times, right?

Name: Computer
Dialog: Unauthorized attire.

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Agent P? In my shop? Is it my birthday? Trapdoors and birthdays are so hard to keep track of, don't you find? (shakes Agent P's hand vigorously, gasps) Good gracious, your hat! Looks like something took a bite out of it.

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: That explains the security bots mistaking you for a threat. Have to admit, seeing you in action back there with all the flipping and the platypussing, wow, just great! I've often fantasized about being in the field, you know, seeing some action. (laughs) I don't get out much. (His hat pours him a cup of tea.) No time for sunlight, really. Hats to sew, weapons to build. (He signs an invoice.) Evil doesn't rest, and neither do we, right? (laughs) Ooh, listen to me, rambling on! We must get you a new hat. This way.

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Oh, you found the trap door! Clever! I'll take the stairs.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, there they are.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yep. There they are.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hmmm. How do I put this delicately? It's not our best work.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Not even our second best.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We can't show these to Phineas.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And Ferb. Wait, this is gonna sound crazy, but what if we combined our efforts?

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's crazy! So crazy it just might work!

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Let's see if we can find you the perfect replacement hat.

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: I mean, sure. But don't you think it's time for an upgrade? Ha ha ha!

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Ooh! My latest model. Teleportation hat. Takes you anywhere you want to go. (He activates the hat.) Hugely experimental, but I have so many others to choose from!

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Oh, but I don't do shoes, that's two doors down. You get the idea. But behind this curtain, Agent P, oh-ho-ho, is my masterpiece. Allow me to present...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mmm. The plaid is delicious, by the way.

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Oooh, Doofenshmirtz! But why does he look like that? And how did he get in? And what—Oh, I see. He ate your hat. He must've swallowed the security chip. That's how he got inside.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (growls) Mine. Mine. Hat's mine! (He flies all over the room in search of hats to chew.)

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Oh, now, this is exciting!

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: (throwing a football helmet to Agent P) That's my touchdown topper.

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: (throws what looks like a fire helmet to Perry) Gives new meaning to the term "bug spray". Ha ha!

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Try this one!

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Don't remember designing that one. Okay, then. I'm all out of hats.

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: What are we gonna do, Agent P?

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Agent P?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is amazing!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, who would've thought that three completely disparate elements would go together so seamlessly?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (raises hand) I would have.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, but ya didn't.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I can't wait for Phineas to see it!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And Ferb.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And Ferb.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: They are going to be so proud of us.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ooh! Let's throw a tarp over it, y'know, for the big reveal!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I think I hear their car!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas! Phineas! Phineas!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Come on, come on, come on!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I guess there's no more hats to eat. Hatmaker will do.

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Uh, you should wait for Agent P. I'm not really much of an action guy, no.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, that was weird.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look, look, look!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, look, look!

Name: Isabella and Candace
Dialog: But but but but but but but but but but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm just gonna add that to my tab. Cha-ching!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nobody thought to take a picture?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great. (sighs) Great instinct turning me back into a human, Perry the Platypus. And frankly preferable to that whole "make everyone else into mothmans" thing, (puts on the aviator cap) 'cause, ya know, "reasons".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aaaah! Thank you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: That's plenty of action for one day. Better to leave the fieldwork to the field agents and the hatmaker to his hats. (gives Perry a new fedora) If it ain't broken, no need to fix it.

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Speaking of broken, looks like it's time for a change of scenery.

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Can't have Heinz Doofenshmirtz with intimate knowledge of our location now, can we? (laughs)

Name: Haberdasher
Dialog: Be seeing you, Agent P. Oooh, happy birthday!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Blegh! Oh, why did I think that would taste good?
